text:
Ava (Growth): Quick heads-up — want to run a 2-week micro experiment on the invite-to-demo funnel. Goal: increase first-5-min retention and demo attendance by testing starter tokens + curated prompt sets.
Jon P: Love it. What's the exact experiment matrix?
Ava (Growth): Two arms: A) baseline invite + generic onboarding links. B) invite that includes 75 starter tokens + 3 tailored prompt templates (code, marketing, support). Also vary CTA timing (immediate vs 1-hour follow-up).
Priya R: Can we scope to new signups from organic blog posts + product Hunt channel only? Keeps traffic consistent.
Ava (Growth): Yes — segment = organic blog + product-hunt tag. Exclude existing customers.
Diego M: Quick ops ask: how will tokens be delivered? In-email link -> console credit redemption flow, right?
Ava (Growth): Correct. Email contains one-click redeem that credits tokens to their account and opens a preloaded prompt pack in the quickstart overlay.
Sam - Ops: I can wire the redeem link + tracking params. Need the UTM + experiment id.
Ava (Growth): Use utm_source=blog-hunt, utm_campaign=starterpack_test_v1, exp_id=1697031111.
Priya R: Metrics to watch: 1) redeem rate, 2) first-5-min usage (tokens spent), 3) demo signup rate within 7 days, 4) 14-day retention of any activity. Success signal = 20% lift in demo signups vs baseline or 15% uplift in first-5-min usage.
Jon P: What about messaging — copy variations? I can draft two email variants and one short launch post.
Ava (Growth): Perfect. One variant emphasizes "try 3 starter prompts" and the other emphasizes "unlock 75 tokens". Keep the post short and product-focused.
martech-bot: Reminder scheduled: create campaign assets due in 24h.
Jon P: Drafts below — please quick review.
Jon P: 
```
Email A (prompt-first):
Subject: Try 3 curated prompts — see what Redwood Inference can do
Hi {{first_name}},
We added 3 starter prompts to your account to help you try generation for code, marketing copy, and customer support. Click Redeem to try them in seconds.
[Redeem starter prompts]
```

Jon P: 
```
Email B (tokens-first):
Subject: 75 starter tokens waiting in your account
Hi {{first_name}},
We put 75 tokens in your account — redeem now and experiment with our prebuilt prompts. No credit card required.
[Redeem tokens]
```
Priya R: Looks good. Small tweak: add a single sentence on security for enterprise leads: "Your data stays private — read more" with a link to docs.
Ava (Growth): Good call. Diego can you add the docs link to both variants?
Diego M: Yep — will append: https://docs.redwood.ai/security (short link for internal).
Sam - Ops: For routing — we should tag anyone who redeems and visits /demo within 7 days as inbound-signal=hot. Send to the PLG SDR queue. Cold redeemers go to nurture.
Priya R: Also capture prompt-template usage id so we can A/B at the prompt level. Event names: starter_redeem, starter_use_prompt_{id}, demo_booking.
Ava (Growth): How do we track attributions for the overlay preloads?
Sam - Ops: The redeem link will set local storage keys and fire a custom analytics event on first overlay open. We'll map that to the user if they login.
Jon P: Timeline — copy final by EOD today, assets to eng by tomorrow noon, martech sends Thursday morning. 2-week measurement window starts day of send.
Diego M: I’ll prototype the redeem endpoint and provide test creds by lunchtime tomorrow.
Priya R: Can we add a small social post to the blog header announcing a "new quickstart" — simple snippet linking to the invite form?
Ava (Growth): Yes. Draft for social: 1 short post + 1 longer thread for Product Hunt. Jon, can you do the short one?
Jon P: Short post draft: "New quickstart: 75 starter tokens + curated prompts to get results fast — try it now." Thoughts?
Priya R: Slight reword: "Try our new quickstart: 75 starter tokens and 3 curated prompts to get results fast." Tone friendly.
Ava (Growth): Approve. Add hashtags: #developers #ai #llm.
martech-bot: Milestone created: experiment-1697031111 (assets, tracking, send).
Sam - Ops: I'll post the experiment dashboard link once it's ready. Expect basic funnel: sent -> clicked -> redeemed -> used -> demo-booked.
Ava (Growth): Final ask — keep creative lean. We want to measure product-first lift, not copy polish. If we see signal, we scale with variations.
Diego M: Understood. I'll drop a small smoke test command here for eng:
```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood.ai/redeem \
  -d '{"user_id":"test-user","exp_id":"1697031111"}'
```
Jon P: Thanks team — will update with final copy in this thread. :rocket:
